name: The grouped e2e completes Hardcore Duo for both members (Pair in the Lair 58)
contract: Pair in the Lair (58) needs a two-player group (GROUP_SIZE 2) and carries a tracked DUO objective.
The test activation never marked the DUO/TRIO objective, so the grouped e2e could not complete a duo or trio trial even when every kill gate was met.
Expected: both members pass the XP cap at level 20, survive a forced level at gate 21 and complete the trial at the level cap.

steps.label: Run the grouped e2e for Pair in the Lair
The run sees the first gate at level 21
XP stops one level short of the first gate
DISCRIMINATING: the full run completes the trial
Neither member dies at a gate
